question: Which of the following sports was NOT played at Tokyo Olympics 2020 held in 2021?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TOKYO OLYMPICS**

 
 
• **The 2020 Olympics was held in Tokyo from 23 July to 8 August 2021.**
 
• The International Olympics Committee postponed the games due to Covid-19.
 
• This was the second time When **Japan will host the Olympics. (First in 1964)**
 
• Miraitowa is the official mascot of the **2020 Summer Olympics.**
 
• The mascot is created by **Japanese artist Ryo Taniguchi.**
 
 
 
• **The International Olympic Committee (IOC)**
 
 
• IOC is a not-for-profit independent international organization.
 
• **Created- 23 June 1894**
 
• The first Olympic Games of the modern era were conducted in **April 1896.**
 
• The Olympic Charter is the codification of the Fundamental Principles of **Olympism.**
 
• **President- Thomas Bach**
 
 
 
• **Olympic Motto- CITIUS – ALTIUS - FORTIUS meaning (FASTER - HIGHER - STRONGER -COMMUNITER)**
 
• **The 138th session of the International Olympic Committee** met between **20-21 July 2021.**
 
• At this meeting, the International Olympic Committee decided to change the Olympic motto **'Citius, Altius, Fortius' to 'Citius, Altius, Fortius, Communiter'.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2020**

 
 
• India won** 7 medals** at **Tokyo Olympics 2020**, which includes **1 Gold, 2 Silver, and 4 Bronze medals.**
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** won a **Gold medal** in the **Javelin Throw event.**
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** won a **Silver medal in Men's Wrestling 57KG category.**
 
• Mirabai Chanu created history winning India’s first medal of the Tokyo Olympics when she clinched **silver in women’s 49kg weightlifting event. **
 
• **P.V. Sindhu** won a **Bronze medal in Women's Singles Badminton.**
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain** won a **Bronze medal in the Women's Welterweight Boxing category.**
 
• Indian Men's Hockey team won the **Bronze medal.**
 
• **Bajrang Punia** won a **Bronze medal in Men's Wrestling 65 KG category.**
